environment: Windows / Node24.19.0 / byte-equivalent owned isolated clone / Vitest V8 and local MSW

finding.rootCause: Owner callbacks can run twice before React pending state commits; failed financial intents replace their key when edited and restored; successful parsing alone does not confirm the requested resource/status. Dust results display a quote as if it were a confirmed receipt.
finding.behavior: Serialize writes synchronously at their owner, retain keys for canonical unconfirmed intents, freeze editable request controls, guard current permission/input, bind response resource IDs or asset targets, and keep pending/unconfirmed states distinct from completed results. No automatic resend.
finding.regressions: Same-turn duplicate callbacks, lost-response retry after returning to an intent, File identity with identical metadata, pending controls, request/resource binding, unconfirmed transitions and receipt-versus-quote display.

limits: Local Windows Node24/MSW evidence only; no backend/staging/UAT or production certification.
Keys and in-flight locks are owned by mounted pages; cross-session durable lookup/replay/atomic authorization remain backend-blocked.
Diagnostic failures are retained and excluded from validated pre-fix fault counts.
No API enum, schema compatibility, route family, thresholds, assertions, skips, baseline or denominator are reduced.
